subject: Backend Engineer Intern – Aditya Mittal
body:
Hi Merkle Science team,

Keeping a Django/FastAPI backend correct when it's feeding AML/KYC decisions off onchain data leaves no room for quiet bugs.

I built MedVault, a Django REST backend with per-user isolation at the queryset level and JWT refresh-token rotation: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I just finished an SDET internship at Basepair, where I fixed a production OAuth race condition. Is the backend intern role still open?
